domains.name: Evaluation of Models, Inferences, and Experimental Results

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses intensely on the interpretation of data presented in various graphs, tables, and charts throughout the multiple-choice sections of the exam, helping candidates develop vital analytical skills for test success.

This domain measures your fundamental understanding of scientific investigation tools, methods, procedures, and the basic principles of experimental design required for complete success across multiple testing formats and careful evaluation procedures.

This domain covers the careful evaluation of complex models, logical inferences, and experimental results to determine their consistency with the provided scientific information during the test and subsequent analytical question sections.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Report to your designated test center on time with your admission ticket, valid photo identification, and required No. 2 pencils. Follow all instructions carefully while testing.

faq.answer_text: The examination contains exactly 40 questions across the multiple-choice section, designed to test your science reasoning skills within a set timeframe for all candidates participating in the testing session.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: Score details and passing requirements vary by institution; check with ACT for specific scoring information and percentiles on your official test report and documentation today.
The exam has a strict duration of exactly 40 minutes, during which you must complete all questions under standard testing conditions and time limits specified by the administration.

The test covers Interpretation of Data, Scientific Investigation, and Evaluation of Models, Inferences, and Experimental Results to assess your overall scientific reasoning abilities accurately during your scheduled testing period.
faq.question_title: What topics are covered in the science test?

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the ACT Science Reasoning exam. Learn about its 40 questions, 40-minute duration, and domains like data interpretation and investigation.

methodology.summary: This page was built using official ACT documentation and verified guidelines to provide factual details on the exam structure and domains for candidates.

editorial.overview: The ACT Science Reasoning test thoroughly covers Interpretation of Data, Scientific Investigation, and Evaluation of Models, Inferences, and Experimental Results across a total of exactly 40 questions within a strict timeframe of exactly 40 minutes for all candidates taking the examination at their designated centers.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Carefully review all official content areas and practice with timed sessions to build your testing endurance. Pace yourself appropriately during the 40-minute test and make sure to answer every single question since guessing carries absolutely no penalty whatsoever across the board.
editorial.who_should_take: Students preparing for college admission who need to demonstrate science reasoning skills will take this test. It suits examinees updating their knowledge in data interpretation and scientific investigation.
